6e60f6c946c617a0f7c2cf7bea85ce39fafb0413.planning: Propagates component occupancy through three movement steps; risk-weighted goal/frontier search plus a short-horizon controller with immediate visible-contact avoidance and a distance potential.
6e60f6c946c617a0f7c2cf7bea85ce39fafb0413.predictive_updates: Enumerates anonymous observable/censored matchings; sums blocked attempted directions into stay masks; decays fast/slow directional evidence; combines both with uniform shrinkage. Reads the public enemy visibility radius.
6e60f6c946c617a0f7c2cf7bea85ce39fafb0413.representation: Replaces feature occupancy rates with separate terrain atlas, directional attempted-movement law, fast/slow evidence, anonymous enemy occupancy cloud and navigation state.
6e60f6c946c617a0f7c2cf7bea85ce39fafb0413.scope: Static inspection only; slot1 produced no measured episodes because the native scheduler charged proposal time against evaluation timeout. No empirical mechanism or performance conclusion is available.
6e60f6c946c617a0f7c2cf7bea85ce39fafb0413.source_limitations: Anonymous overlap, nuisance births and hidden occupancy are approximations. learn/predictive_planning flags are present but have not been behaviorally audited in RUN1. Static presence does not establish predictive adaptation benefit.
